t: Does Code-Switching Make You Less Latina? - Peligrosa HQ
d: We navigate the complexities of identity, and the various ways Latinas navigate their presentation across different environments. Gaby Ulloa joins us to help the Peligrosas reset the way they think about career changes.

t: De Cocula Es El Mariachi - Hunters
d: El Mariachi es una de las representaciones más importantes de México en el mundo, viajamos a Cocula, cuna del Mariachi a conocer su origen, significado y demás tradiciones y leyendas que rodean a este hermoso pueblo mágico en Jalisco México.

t: Capítulo I: Tlaltenco Es Comunidad - Hunters
d: A las orillas de CDMX y Estado de México existe un lugar con tradiciones llenas de colores identidad, Tlaltenco es conocido por sus fiestas patronales y bailes, trajes de charro con hilo de oro y plata y el gran festejo entre comparsas.

t: Capítulo II: Tlaltenco Es Comunidad - Hunters
d: Segunda parte de Tlaltenco, donde la magia es representada entre mitos y leyendas, el festejo de coronación de la reyna que envuelve no sólo a los habitantes de esta comunidad atrayendo a turistas de todo el mundo.

t: Building Blocks: Building Community & Owning Our Journey - Blacktinidad
d: Our hosts address the importance authenticity and knowing yourself when building community finding your village. They are then joined by Veteran Actor and Star of award winning series "This is Us", Jon Huertas who shares his unique journey.

d: Amanda Jimenez is a super soccer mom who coaches toddlers in efforts to establish and encourage a community at a young age.

t: LA Rapid Response Network - Chirla TV
d: Attorneys Sylvia Ortiz and Laura Urias join us in this episode to talk about the LA Raid Rapid Response Network and how you can organize to protect your community. Spread Power, Not Fear! Know Your Rights!

t: Mental Health Discussion With Founder of LatinX Therapy - Chirla TV
d: We are so excited to be joined by Adriana Alejandre, Founder of Latinx Therapy, in this special discussion about mental health, the importance of seeking help, and dealing with the cultural challenges and taboos surrounding it.

t: Chirla Responds to LA Fires - Chirla TV
d: CHIRLA's membership and member services team sprung into action after the most destructive fires in Los Angeles history. Join us to learn about the iRelief program and how you can contribute to the fund that is providing much needed financial support.

d: You know that cousin who’s always doing too much for no reason? Laritza’s nonstop dramatics, mood swings, and main-character energy somehow turn every minor inconvenience into a full production, bro!

d: Growing up with Latino parents means nothing is ever simple. From overreactions to overprotecting to full-on chaos in public, Flor and Benito somehow turn everyday parenting into a full-blown spectacle.

d: Everybody has an aunt who lives for the drama and makes sure everyone else does too. The hilariously unfiltered, gossip-loving Tía Maruchi, with a larger-than-life personality, turns everyday moments into full-blown spectacles.

t: Sexual Freedom - The Q Agenda
d: Queer sex therapist Dr. Chris Donaghue returns to explain 'sexual bypassing' and how it affects intimacy with partners.

t: Excuse My Beauty - The Q Agenda
d: The Q Agenda kicks off Season 11 with a fresh dose of glamour and star power!

t: Balancing Family & Fame - The Q Agenda
d: Family or fame: do you have to pick? Our hosts discuss the pros and cons. Actor Rafael de la Fuente opens up about how his pride has changed. Music producer Celimar tells us why Los Angeles is starting to feel like home.

t: Losing Weight While Enjoying Eating? - Esencia: Latina Wellness
d: Katherine Castro sits down with Helen Leeds and Penelope Popken, the mother-daughter founders of Step It Up, to unpack the real foundations of their 260-pound natural weight loss journey.

t: The Ageless Blonde: Benefits of Peptide Therapy - Esencia: Latina Wellness
d: On today’s episode we’re joined by Amber Cameneti, known as The Ageless Blonde, a Beverly Hills–based Registered Nurse specializing in peptide therapy, regenerative wellness, and concierge longevity medicine.

t: The Sukshma Method and the Power of Breathwork - Esencia: Latina Wellness
d: Today we are beyond excited to have the cofounder of Naam Global and co writer of the book Breath as Medicine, Renata Spironello. She teaches the Sukshmah method with a clear mission, to heal people one breath at a time.

t: Latino Is Not A Genre - Cultura Shock
d: Rafael Agustin, writer of shows like 'Jane The Virgin' joins the show. We get to know regional singer Padrinito Toys. Actors Carolina Moreno & Jason Canela clapback at Hollywood stereotypes. Then producer/artist Ali Stone shares her music experience.

t: Mezcal Etiquette and the Cuban Miami Experience - Cultura Shock
d: Privacy expert Cathy Pedrayes shares eye opening safety advice so that we can all be more secure. Cuban-Americans Julia Musolino, Humberto Guida, Jason Canela paint the picture of life in Miami.

t: Sahana Srinivasan and Regional Rhythms - Cultura Shock
d: Actor and comedian Sahana Srinivasan shares with us the Indian-American experience in their show 'The Pradeeps of Pittsburgh'. The band Black Oxygen clapback at music criticism and Julio Cesar breaks down the rhythms of Mexican Regional music.
